text.body: || dhanalakṣmīstotram || dhanadā uvāca devī devamupāgamya nīlakaṇṭhaṃ mama priyam | kṛpayā pārvatī prāha śaṃkaraṃ karuṇākaram || devyuvāca brūhi vallabha sādhūnāṃ daridrāṇāṃ kuṭumbinām | daridra dalanopāyamaṃjasaiva dhanapradam || śiva uvāca pūjayan pārvatīvākyamidamāha maheśvaraḥ | ucitaṃ jagadambāsi tava bhūtānukampayā || sa sītaṃ sānujaṃ rāmaṃ sāṃjaneyaṃ sahānugam | praṇamya paramānandaṃ vakṣye'haṃ stotramuttamam || dhanadaṃ śraddhānānāṃ sadyaḥ sulabhakārakam | yogakṣemakaraṃ satyaṃ satyameva vaco mama || paṭhaṃtaḥ pāṭhayaṃto'pi brahmaṇairāstikottamaiḥ | dhanalābho bhavedāśu nāśameti daridratā || bhūbhavāṃśabhavāṃ bhūtyai bhaktikalpalatāṃ śubhām | prārthayattāṃ yathākāmaṃ kāmadhenusvarūpiṇīm || dhanade dhanade devi dānaśīle dayākare | tvaṃ prasīda maheśāni! yadarthaṃ prārthayāmyaham || dharā'marapriye puṇye dhanye dhanadapūjite | sudhanaṃ rdhāmike dehi yajamānāya satvaram || ramye rudrapriye rūpe rāmarūpe ratipriye | śikhīsakhamanomūrtte prasīda praṇate mayi || āraktacaraṇāmbhoje siddhisarvārthadāyike | divyāmbaradhare divye divyamālyānuśobhite || samastaguṇasampanne sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite | śaraccandramukhe nīle nīla nīraja locane || caṃcarīka camū cāru śrīhāra kuṭilālake | matte bhagavatī mātaḥ kalakaṇṭharavāmṛte || hāsā'valokanairdivyairbhaktacintāpahārike | rūpa lāvaṇya tārūṇya kārūṇya guṇabhājane || kvaṇatkaṃkaṇamaṃjīre lasallīlākarāmbuje | rudraprakāśite tattve dharmādhare dharālaye || prayaccha yajamānāya dhanaṃ dharmekasādhanam | mātastvaṃ me'vilambena diśasva jagadambike || kṛpayā karurāgāre prārthitaṃ kuru me śubhe | vasudhe vasudhārūpe vasu vāsava vandite || dhanade yajamānāya varade varadā bhava | brahmaṇyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ pūjye pārvatīśivaśaṃkare || stotraṃ daridratāvyādhiśamanaṃ sudhanapradam | śrīkare śaṃkare śrīde prasīda mayikiṃkare || pārvatīśaprasādena sureśa kiṃkareritam | śraddhayā ye paṭhiṣyanti pāṭhayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ || sahasramayutaṃ lakṣaṃ dhanalābho bhaved dhruvam | dhanadāya namastubhyaṃ nidhipadmādhipāya ca | bhavantu tvatprasādānme dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ || || iti śrī dhanalakṣmī stotraṃ sampūrṇam
